checker.tool: Codex desktop with source inspection, frozen executables, Java PlantUML JAR, xmllint, and uv-run SVG geometry tracing

verdict_gate: Parity Honesty Rule 10 is absolute for this review: any fresh held-out whose frozen diff_one --no-oracle exit is nonzero rejects the mechanism. Geometry classification does not create a scope waiver, and no mechanism-only pass classification was applied.
verdict_reason: Fresh valid held-outs across top, bottom, left, and right notes returned nonzero from diff_one --no-oracle. The shadow on/off pair directly falsifies the painted-envelope claim: Java's ComponentRoseNote preferred dimension includes deltaShadow, shifts the merged label, paints a shadow filter, and grows the canvas from 234 to 237px; frozen Rust renders the on variant identically to shadow-off at 234px. Multiline center labels and nested negative note bounds provide additional valid nonzero counterexamples.

java_model: SvekEdge.java:279-318 creates labelOnly, creates EntityImageNoteLink for a link note, then merges note and label with mergeLR or mergeTB according to left/right/top/bottom position.

SvekEdge.java:433-436 computes the merged TextBlock dimension; appendTable at lines 497-506 truncates it to integer fixed-size Graphviz table dimensions. SvekEdge.drawU at lines 944-947 paints the original merged labelText at the solved table origin.

EntityImageNoteLink.java:69-77 reports the ComponentRoseNote preferred dimension and paints that component. ComponentRoseNote.java:78-85 adds two-sided padding and symbolContext.getDeltaShadow to both preferred width and height.

LimitFinder.java:155-210 measures actual path, polygon, rectangle, image, ellipse, and text primitives. Rectangle bounds include deltaShadow*2; UPath bounds themselves use path extrema. SvekResult.java:130-135 translates the global painted minimum to six and returns painted span plus fifteen.
rust_model: deployment_link_note_painted_bounds reconstructs merged note/label origins, includes the floored note rectangle, and includes measured center-label text instead of the whole fixed Graphviz placeholder. deployment_edge_paint_bounds unions this with route and endpoint-label primitives.

The implementation is causal and pre-render: bounds are computed from the parsed model, measured text, solved layout, and painted primitives before canvas framing. No Java SVG or golden SVG is read and no emitted SVG is rewritten.

deployment_link_note_dim delegates only to deployment_note_text_dim. It has no shadow contribution, and render_deployment_link_note emits no filter or shadow primitive. The frozen shadow-on output is byte-structurally equivalent to shadow-off in all traced note geometry and remains 234px high.

deployment_body_x_frame and deployment_body_y_frame return None whenever cluster IDs exist. cluster_frame then establishes the origin without edge_paint_bounds minima, while total width/height only max-expand with edge maxima. A negative link-note minimum can therefore remain clipped in nested diagrams.
fixture_shape_and_tuning_audit: No golden-data reads, include_str/include_bytes fixture embedding, checker label branches, fixture names, per-branch-count constant ladders, coordinate-keyed rewrites, comparator changes, or post-render SVG mutation were found in the implementation diff.

The change is primitive/type/position shaped and adds no high-precision decimal. Its floor, +1 text origin, +2 label envelope, and position branches are plausibly traceable to Java integer tables and one-pixel text margins, but the new helper's adjacent comment does not cite exact Java source lines for every parity-affecting literal and branch.
The implementation does not tune by note text, branch count, source line, coordinate signature, or fixture stem.

geometry_trace.method: trace_geometry.py parses each same-stem Java and Rust SVG, records root canvas/viewBox/error status, locates each link group, computes bounds from the folded-note path coordinates, records filter attributes, and derives text right edges using x plus serialized textLength. It does not alter outputs or comparator behavior.
direct_note_envelope_failures: Shadow pair: Java shadow-off and Rust shadow-off are identical at 308x234. Java shadow-on retains the base note path at x=103.12..293.12/y=87.49..112.49, adds a filter, shifts the center label from (132.6979,131.3689) to (134.1979,134.3689), and grows canvas height to 237. Rust shadow-on remains filterless at the off coordinates and 234 height.

Bottom multiline pair: Java's two center-label baselines are y=96.0584 and 111.3689; Rust emits replicate, literal \n, and phase two on one y=96.0584 baseline. The Rust note begins y=104.8005 instead of Java y=120.1111 and the canvas loses 16px.
Left undecorated pair: folded-note paths match exactly, but Java's center label occupies two lines and a 371px canvas; Rust's one literal-\n run reaches x=444.1906 and forces a 459px canvas.
global_frame_traces: Nested left cross-container: Java's folded note is entirely visible at x=6..153; Rust computes x=-78.9953..68.0047. Source inspection traces this to cluster_frame winning origin selection while body x/y frames return None in the presence of clusters; edge bounds only max-expand total dimensions afterward.
Right Deployment root: the folded-note local size is identical, but Rust applies a global -1x/-0.51y shift and returns a canvas one pixel smaller in each dimension.
These global-frame classifications satisfy the requested geometry distinction, but Rule 10 treats their nonzero held-outs as rejecting evidence. They are not excluded from the verdict.

findings.title: Shadow-inclusive ComponentRoseNote bounds are absent
evidence: geometry-trace-attempt-2.stdout.txt records Java 308x237 with a filter and shifted center label, versus Rust 308x234 with no filter and off-control coordinates.
ComponentRoseNote.java:78-85 includes symbolContext.getDeltaShadow in both preferred dimensions; deployment_link_note_dim has no shadow input or contribution.
findings.cause: Rust's model measures and paints only the base folded note. It does not represent Java's shadow-inflated preferred dimensions or shadow primitive, so merged-note placement and the LimitFinder envelope diverge when shadowing is enabled.

findings.title: Multiline center labels do not participate as Java text blocks
evidence: geometry traces show Java line-separated text and Rust literal \n text runs, with 16px height loss in the bottom case and 88px width growth in the left case.
findings.cause: The no-oracle center-label measurement/emission path treats the parsed escaped newline as one measured string rather than Java's multi-line Display/TextBlock, changing both the merged placeholder and actual painted primitive envelope.

findings.title: Nested edge minima do not drive the global LimitFinder origin
evidence: Java note minX is 6; Rust note minX is -78.9953 and visibly outside the SVG viewBox.
deployment_body_x_frame and deployment_body_y_frame return None with clusters, while edge_paint_bounds only max-expands total dimensions after cluster_frame establishes margins.
findings.cause: Rust separates cluster framing from edge painted minima, unlike Java's one global LimitFinder pass over clusters, entities, links, labels, and notes.

findings.title: Further valid direction/style/dispatch perturbations are nonzero
findings.cause: The preserved full-render diffs cover stroke width/style, reversed arrow orientation, component-first dispatch, and right-position global framing. Rule 10 makes each nonzero independently rejecting.

residues: Root left merged notes and the shadow-off top control are comparator-clean, demonstrating that the helper can match a narrow base case.
The valid reversed top note has matching note paths, text, canvas, and viewBox but remains comparator-nonzero due route/style output; it is rejecting evidence, not an out-of-scope exception.

Three exploratory color-style forms are invalid in the pinned Java oracle. Their sources and every generated/error artifact remain preserved, but rejection rests on eleven valid inputs with nine nonzero results.
The source model is not fixture-shaped and does not perform SVG surgery, but mechanism-shaped implementation is insufficient when fresh no-oracle held-outs are nonzero.
No Cargo, rustc, no-oracle bypass, comparator modification, baseline update, fixture exemption, or artifact deletion was used.
